name: Realtime
description: Websocket wiring: broadcast auth behind Sanctum so bearer-token clients work too, a served client config so one build runs against any environment, one shared Echo connection, and a banner for when the socket drops. Ships no container — the Reverb service and its worktree gotcha are documented.

on.label: Yes — a bar that appears when live updates stop arriving

off.label: No — the composable exposes the state and the app decides
